modules.name: Retro
modules.description: An open source game browser and NES player made for low end TVs. It downloads free homebrew games from their authors' own pages and checks each one before it is stored. Your own game files in the Roms folder on the TV show up too.

permissions.plain_words: Downloads free homebrew games and cover art over HTTPS.
Reads your own game files from the Roms/NES folder on the TV.
Used only inside Retro itself; no other app can use it.

versions.network: Connects only to the pages and download links of the games you pick, and to their cover art, over HTTPS.

modules.name: Nuvio
modules.one_line: Movies and shows from the add-ons you choose
modules.description: The official Nuvio app for Android TV: a media hub with a TV interface, Trakt sync and its own player. It comes with no content; what it can play depends on the add-ons you add to it yourself.

modules.name: SmartTube
modules.one_line: YouTube for the TV, without ads
modules.description: An open source YouTube player made for TVs and remotes: no ads, SponsorBlock to skip sponsor segments, 4K and 60 fps, and no Google services needed. It is not made or approved by YouTube or Google.
